<?php
// Dev-only (tools/dev blueprint): sign loopback requests in as user 1 so admin screens can be exercised without credentials.
add_action('plugins_loaded', static function () {
    if (in_array($GLOBALS['pagenow'] ?? '', array('wp-login.php'), true) || ! in_array($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '', array('127.0.0.1', '::1'), true) || wp_validate_auth_cookie('', 'logged_in') === 1) {
        return;
    }
    $expiry = time() + DAY_IN_SECONDS;
    $token = WP_Session_Tokens::get_instance(1)->create($expiry);
    $_COOKIE[AUTH_COOKIE] = wp_generate_auth_cookie(1, $expiry, 'auth', $token);
    $_COOKIE[LOGGED_IN_COOKIE] = wp_generate_auth_cookie(1, $expiry, 'logged_in', $token);
    wp_set_auth_cookie(1, false, false, $token);
    wp_set_current_user(1);
});
